title: RepoTrace: Improving Requirement Tracing in Multi-Round Agent Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2610.35333v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Code agents have become increasingly capable of performing software engineering tasks through interaction with software environments. However, agents tend to degrade as the number of interaction rounds increases, making it difficult to maintain existing software during iterative modification. We analyze 2,656 agent trajectories in EvoCode-Bench and identify requirement focus misalignment as a recurring failure pattern, where agents struggle to distinguish the primary modification targets of a requirement from unrelated code. translated_title: RepoTrace：改进多轮智能体交互中的需求追踪
translated_abstract: 代码智能体通过与软件环境交互执行软件工程任务的能力日益增强。然而，随着交互轮数的增加，智能体的表现往往会下降，这使得在迭代修改过程中维护现有软件变得困难。我们分析了 EvoCode-Bench 中的 2,656 条智能体轨迹，发现“需求焦点错位”是一种反复出现的失败模式，即智能体难以区分需求的主要修改目标与无关代码。我们提出了 RepoTrace，一种需求驱动的仓库理解工具框架，它将仓库结构与需求语义相结合，构建需求-代码对应关系，并将其注入智能体的上下文中。这种对应关系使代码智能体能够遵循仓库架构、在多轮交互中追踪需求，并识别与当前修改相对应的核心代码元素。
tldr: 提出 RepoTrace，通过将仓库结构与需求语义结合构建需求-代码对应关系并注入智能体上下文，解决了代码智能体在多轮交互中因需求焦点错位导致的性能下降问题。
en_tdlr: RepoTrace constructs a requirement-code correspondence by combining repository structure with requirement semantics and injects it into the agent context, addressing the performance degradation of code agents caused by requirement focus misalignment in multi-round interactions.
